info.name: erlang
info.category: Managed — BEAM bytecode (Erlang VM; BeamAsm JIT)
info.typing: Dynamically and strongly typed; Dialyzer specs are optional
info.gc: Per-process generational collector — no global stop-the-world pauses
info.design_notes: Erlang was built for massively concurrent, fault-tolerant, soft-real-time systems. It runs on the BEAM with the same lightweight processes, per-process GC, and BeamAsm JIT as Elixir. Numeric throughput is not its goal; it wins on concurrency, distribution, and predictable latency.
key_traits: Lightweight processes with isolated per-process heaps
Per-process GC: no global pause, low latency
BeamAsm JIT compiles hot bytecode to native
Pattern matching and recursion over loops; immutable data
info.peak_speed: Several× to ~10× slower than C++ on arithmetic
